'''Falconberry''' was a type of [[Berry/Legends|berry]] found on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Some falconberries grew not far from the castle that had once belonged to [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna's]] ancestor, the [[Earl of Vis/Legends|Earl of Vis]].<ref name="DarthPlagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
